totals.tests_note: corrected 636->629 to match sum(per_file.tests) and census (karen phase-1 gate finding)

per_file.note: By-design measurement instrument: all 15 TEST bodies use SUCCEED()/RecordProperty only (L187), ZERO EXPECT_/ASSERT_. finishRow() explicitly leaves the test green whether or not autosave captured the edit. A run where every family's capture_present==NO passes.

EmptyPath/NullByte/ADS are real EXPECT_THROW security gates (L37,45,55). RelativePathTraversalAllowed is EXPECT_NO_THROW-only (L67); LongPathHandledGracefully (L71) and UNCPathInSaveTarget (L86) are bare try/catch with ZERO assertions.

Slow-gated benchmark. Round-trip 'correctness' is only pdf_count_pages>0 (L173); sole assertion EXPECT_TRUE(anyData) (L298). A save that corrupts every page but keeps pages>0 passes as 'round-trips clean'.
Throw-guard tests are sound (L44,66,72). SaveToFile verifies only reopen + pageCount()==3 (L104) — a save that drops page content but preserves count passes.

Index-boundary EXPECT_THROW tests are true (L41,48,54). RotateOutOfRangeAngle is EXPECT_NO_THROW-only (L61-74, never checks rotation); DeletePageAtInvalidIndex is a bare try/catch with ZERO assertions (L81-93).

isPortfolio true/false and embedded-file names are real (L40,93-100). But portfolioView()=="D" is checked identically for the portfolio fixture (L51) and the fallback default (L73) — the getter default equals the fixture value, so it cannot distinguish 'read /View/D' from 'returned spec default'.

UndoRestoresOriginal is a text before==restored round-trip (L78) but NEVER asserts textAfter != textBefore, so a replacePage that silently no-ops passes. ReplacePagePreservesPageCount (L40) is count-only proxy.

Strong open-refusal security gates (UNC/http/smb/file-scheme, L239-278). OpenNonPdfMagicBytes/OpenEmptyFile wrap EXPECT_THROW inside catch(...) (L52-57,68-73) which silently swallows a WRONG non-Pdfe exception type.

DiffEngine unit tests (similarity/pixel-diff) are heuristic-true. CompareDialog half (10 tests, L256-306) is pure findChild existence. CompareIdenticalDocuments diffs test_3page against ITSELF (L190-202) so similarity~1.0 is tautological — a comparator hardwired to 1.0 passes.

Extract tests reopen output and check only pageCount() e.g. EXPECT_EQ(pageCount(),2) (L77) — never WHICH pages nor order; ExtractPages_ReverseOrder can emit forward order and pass. Error-path EXPECT_THROW tests are sound.

2 strong probes assert apiType=="undefined" (L113). 5 of 7 security tests are bare EXPECT_NO_THROW over XSS/injection/infinite-loop behavior — successful malicious execution that doesn't crash is indistinguishable from correct inert handling.
Search results discarded via (void)hits (L42); only oracle is EXPECT_GT(documentCount(),0). An index that builds but returns zero/wrong hits for present text passes.

RoundTripXfdf/ImportXfdf are true value round-trips EXPECT_EQ(restoredField.value,testValue1) (L217). But export tests only substring-check XML shell; XfdfContainsOnlyNonEmptyValues (L344) admits it can't check content, checks '<fields>' exists, then SUCCEED().
Exact byte-equality on encoder output EXPECT_EQ(out,QByteArray("q=hello+world&k=a%26b")) (L62) and exact allowlist normalization. Strong.

Fixtures have no outline so validation loop bodies never execute; explicit tautologies remain: EXPECT_GE(bookmarks.size(),0u) (L74) and EXPECT_GE(child->title.size(),0u) (L98) are always-true on unsigned. A broken extractor returning empty passes.
Exact decision enums + live POST verifies exact wire body EXPECT_EQ(mock.lastBody(),body) (L150) plus status/response. Strong.

execute/undo/redo verify field values EXPECT_EQ(readBack.title,"New Test Title") (L69) but via readMetadata on the SAME in-memory doc — never save+reopen, so disk persistence is unproven. Plus 2 NO_THROW-only tests.

Engine tests assert result counts (sound), but ~20 BatchDialog tests are findChild!=nullptr existence checks; MultipleActionsExecuteSequentially only checks fileResults.size()==1 with 'May succeed or fail' comment (L133) — an action that never mutates the PDF passes.
Negative-path: EXPECT_ANY_THROW AND verifies target intact EXPECT_EQ(file_size(target),originalSize) (L81), catching silent-truncation data loss. Strong.

Menu objectName/text invariants fine, but InsertBookmarkAddsToManager only checks the boolean return, admitting 'No crash, no assertions = the seam contract holds' (L187) — a no-op insert that returns true passes despite the test name.
Set/toggle verify actual field values EXPECT_EQ(updated.value,"Hello World") (L136); tab-order permutation checked. ResetForm NO_THROW guards are documented mutation-verified seams. Strong.

Nearly all oracles are success()/sizeAfter>0/reopens/pageCount. The security-named OptimizeDoesNotLeakDeletedFormFieldValues asserts only EXPECT_GT(pageCount(),0) (L194) — never checks the leak it is named for.
buildXmpPacket tests do find("1")/find("B")!=npos (L50-52) — a bare '1' or 'B' matches anywhere in the packet (timestamps/UUIDs), can't fail. WritePdfA_ThenDetect (L198) is a genuine strong oracle.
create/rename/move/undo verify titles+structure; CommitSurvivesSaveReload does full save+reopen EXPECT_EQ(reloaded[1]->children[0]->title,"Section 2.1") (L228). Model file for the cluster.
Verifies actual widget state/values EXPECT_EQ(combo->currentText(),"Canada") (L99) and signal payloads; a few stack-index-only existence checks.
Authoritative QPDF isLinearized() oracle with matched negative control EXPECT_FALSE isLinearized on linearize=false (L59). Flag genuinely drives behavior. Strong.

do/undo/redo on pageCount + currentRotation are real, but Move/Import page identity checked only via widthPt/heightPt equality (L390) — a weak identity proxy when all fixture pages share a size; a mis-indexed move passes.

Tests 5-10 write then read back WITHOUT save/reopen (in-memory same-path); only Test 14 persists to disk — and only the Title field. Construct/ReadMetadata_Default/ReadField_* are NO_THROW-only (L37,50,69,213,220,261).

Byte-prefix invariant is a real oracle after.compare(0,before.size(),before)==0 (L74). ThrowsWhenDocumentHasNoFilePath is mis-named — only EXPECT_NO_THROW's the happy path (L177), never exercises the throw it claims.
Exact run-boundary/family assertions dominate (L107-111). Edge cases are NO_THROW-only (L530,533,536,553,596); ReversedRange (L570) has ZERO assertions in body (comment 'should not crash' only).
Real correctness oracle EXPECT_EQ(result.value,"5") after calculateAll (L95) and 10+7==17 (L115); kills the fires-but-computes-nothing mutant. Skips if fixture absent.

save->reopen->assert pageCount/rotation/pageInfo (L168,205,301). Path-safety tests assert throw + no-stray-file. Save_AfterInsertBlank checks only count not inserted-page identity, but overall strong.

Byte-level isIncrementalAppend() oracle + sessionRequiresFullRewrite taint flags (L120,164,257). Security-relevant redaction-must-full-rewrite assertion is real. FormFillSaveIsFastOnXfa is env-gated skip.
3 of 4 stop at getFormFields().size()>0 (L53,70,182). Only IrsW9FieldFillAndSavePreservesValue does save+reopen+value-equality (L141), and it wraps fill/save in EXPECT_NO_THROW.

Content tests use text-extract proxy (L177). Signal tests emit the signal themselves then assert spy.count()==1 (L290-291,316-317) — tautological, real drag/reorder path never driven. DeleteLastPage ends in SUCCEED() (L149).

Real behavior oracles: checkbox toggles value (L115), type+commit EXPECT_EQ(after.value,"Test") (L223), Escape restores original (L186). FieldCreatedCallback (L303) only re-invokes the callback it set — minor.

Primary test diffs test_3page vs ITSELF so expectedRegions=0 -> asserts 0==0 vacuously (L68-84). OneHundredPageDiffMeasurement asserts only totalPages==100 and LOGS elapsed with no timing bound (L191-192).
Structural XML parse + save/reopen + byte-equal value round-trip incl. Unicode EXPECT_EQ(reField.value,unicode_value) (L208). Explicitly avoids substring-match weakness. Strong.
Real mechanism oracles: EXPECT_NO_THROW vs EXPECT_ANY_THROW on save under held-DisplayList vs held-Page (L110,135) + reopen pageCount==3. Deterministic regression, well-controlled.
execute/undo/redo value-equality in-memory (L77,85,130) — real for command logic but NEVER saves/reopens, so a set-widget-cache-but-fail-to-write-/V persistence regression stays green.
Pure in-memory state oracle on a mock counter; every test asserts exact restored value EXPECT_EQ(counter_,0) after undo (L82). True state for the undo engine.

Dominant pattern is 'save then reopen != nullptr' with no content assertion; SaveClearsDirtyPages/MultipleMarkPageDirty stop at ASSERT_NE(reopened,nullptr) (L142,187). Only SaveAsPreservesPageInfo checks a real value (width/height).
Asserts exact inspectable GC seam value EXPECT_EQ(doc->effectiveGarbageLevel(),3) (L136) and needsFullGc() per edit family. Slow XFA timing test env-gated skip.

Mostly exact in-memory state: field count deltas + type/name/rect equality (L72-75), do/undo/redo counts. Flatten-then-create tests are NO_THROW+non-crash guards (L366-384) matching their crash-regression intent.

Bimodal: strong (ResetForm asserts /DV across save+reopen L333-408; Xfdf round-trip L287) vs degenerate: SignatureWidgetTypeIsDistinct is SUCCEED+compile-time tautology (L489), PushButtonToggleNoCrash NO_THROW-only (L209), RadioGroupExclusivity never re-checks sibling radio (L176).
formatNumber value checks (L27-52) plus real save+reopen readback of /PageLabels style/prefix/startValue (L149-157). Asserts exact struct fields, not just reopen-ok.

Core cases assert output page count == sum by reopening (L86-88). But WizardExposesNamedControls is widget-exists-only (L168-179) and TenTenPageCombineMeasurement only LOGs elapsed, asserts only page count (L198).

Model mutate->save->reopen->assert exact field value EXPECT_EQ(reField.value,"round_trip_value") (L89) + negative EXPECT_NE. ResetFormDoesNotRetainStale oracle is save==memory consistency, cannot detect a no-op reset on fields lacking /DV (L176-184).
Exact-string readback after save+reopen incl. Unicode/RTL/CJK/emoji (L113) and empty-string-clears negative (L94). Strongest oracle set in cluster; fixtures ASSERT-exist (hard-fail not skip).

Event-ordering tests assert exact callback sequence (L72,224) — true. But 4 of 7 are pure EXPECT_NO_THROW on fireDocumentEvent (L110,127-131,180-182) and the file admits the willSave SCRIPT side-effect is unobservable (L139-150).
Enum toPdf/fromPdf round-trip (L22) + default-construction field defaults (L45-60). Pure value oracle.

Parses saved bytes via QPDF, asserts structural check ok + startxref>=2 + file grew (L124-135) and that un-modeled features (EmbeddedFiles/AcroForm/Signature) survive by inspecting /Names,/AcroForm,/ByteRange (L238). Vacuity-guarded precondition (L208).

Deterministic crash/UAF repro: NO_THROW undo + exact pageCount restored after save (L150,202); Site2 loops 3x for heap-nondeterminism. Last test ends SUCCEED() (L315) but oracle there is process-survival (a UAF crashes), legitimate for the bug class.

Content oracle: resolves bookmark/link destinations by unique per-page text marker across delete/reorder/move + full save+reopen, asserts each still points at the SAME marker and deleted targets don't dangle (L223,298,353). Survives object renumbering. Gold standard.

Reopens recovery copy in a FRESH context and asserts the edit persisted via real oracles: RedactionVerifier.verify (L131), bookmark count>=before+1 (L172), PageLabel style readback (L206), layer present (L260).

Real content oracle: reopens decompressed stream, asserts new-first-page carries '(Page N)' and NOT '(Page 1)' (L195-201). Only first+last page verified; interior-page scramble/dup/drop survives (pageCount==500 also survives a swap). Timing/size bounds can't fail.
Strongest byte oracle: byte-exact raw-stream compare after real saveAs EXPECT_EQ(after.rawBytes,jpeg) (L300) and EXPECT_EQ(after.rawBytes,before.rawBytes) (L331). No reopen-only shortcut.

HappyPath asserts reopened->pageCount()==4 i.e. edit persisted (L238). But the failure-branch recovery save is verified only by reopen+pageCount>0 (L166) and NO_THROW (L153) — a recovery save that writes a pre-edit file passes.

Strong: every cell reopens the recovery copy in a FRESH context and asserts the exact edit (oracleFormValue L227, oracleMetaTitle L235); UndoToPartial asserts kept-edit present AND undone-edit ABSENT (L774-775). Count cells use '>=baseline+editNo' so a duplication-on-snapshot passes.
Asserts Info title == V2 (L103) AND XMP contains V2 and NOT stale V1 (L109-112). Real cross-store consistency oracle on distinctive sentinels.
filePageContainsSpanText reopens the recovery copy and asserts the unsaved edit is present (L174) AND that the untouched source still holds the ORIGINAL and NOT the edit (L178-181). Mutation-honest.

Dialog-internal set/get roundtrip is real (L154-161) but NEVER touches a Document — zero persistence coverage. Construct is NO_THROW+objectName (L54-60); HasAllWidgets is pure findChild existence (L81-91). Dialog->save wiring untested anywhere.

Strong rebind/undo oracle: getAnnotations().size()==countAfterCreate-1 after post-save undo (L144). But the on-disk save is validated only by reopen+pageCount==3 (L133) — the annotation's persistence into the saved file is never checked (drop-on-disk passes).

Very strong sidecar layer: field-by-field JSON schema + exact values (L185-203), scan returns EXACTLY one valid record excluding 5 malformed variants (L271), debounce timestamp-unchanged (L624). The recovery PDF copy itself is only reopen+pageCount checked (capture covered elsewhere).

Parametrized over 9 families. Post-throw assertion accepts BOTH a clean return AND a thrown exception as pass (undoReturnedCleanly=true in both branches, L279-286) — only a hard crash/UAF fails it, and only on an ASan build. Undo correctness never asserted.

Parametrized 5 families with real do/save/undo/redo state oracles (metadata title L143, bookmark count L228, signature count L311). OCR family is self-referential: 'ocred'/'invalidated' sets are filled by the command's OWN callbacks (L246-247), so it verifies the command calls its own lambdas, not document state.

ranked_weak_findings.user_visible_failure_missed: Autosave silently fails to capture ANY edit family on crash (the exact data-loss class this project keeps shipping) and every one of the 15 tests stays green: finishRow() records capture_present=NO as passing DATA and the only statement is SUCCEED(). Zero EXPECT_/ASSERT_ in the whole file. A crash-recovery regression that drops all edits produces a green suite.

Optimize (garbage=4) leaves stale/deleted form-field values or removed content embedded in the output; the test reopens and asserts only pageCount>0 (L194), so the exact data-leak the test is NAMED for ships green.

After a save that throws (file locked), undo() can undo the WRONG op / corrupt the page / leave inconsistent edit state and the test stays green — both a clean return and any thrown exception satisfy the oracle. Only a hard crash on an ASan build fails it; on Debug/Release a logic-corrupting rebind passes.

docA and docB are both test_3page.pdf (SetUp L54-57) so changedPages/expectedRegions are 0; the entire change-highlighting path is asserted only against 0==0. A dialog that computes change counts completely wrong for real differing docs passes.

Writer emits a malformed pdfaid part/conformance (part=3, wrong letter). Asserting only that substrings "1" and "B" appear ANYWHERE in the packet (timestamps/UUIDs contain both) cannot detect wrong/missing PDF/A identification. Same pattern L66/68,82/84,98/100,114/116,150/152.

insertBookmark returns true but never inserts the node (or inserts wrong title/index). The test checks only the boolean return and explicitly gives up on the model oracle ('BookmarkPanel doesn't expose manager_', L187), so a no-op insert that returns true passes despite the test name.

Captures textAfter (L68) but NEVER asserts textAfter != textBefore. If replacePage silently no-ops, textAfter==textBefore and the undo round-trip trivially passes — a page-replace that does nothing (user's replacement lost) ships green.

writeMetadata may stage 8 fields in an in-memory dict never serialized on save; readMetadata reads the same in-memory dict so all 8 EXPECT_EQ pass, yet the saved file carries no title/author/dates. Only Title is ever save/reopen-verified (Test 14).

Value equality is checked only against the in-memory FormManager; the field is never saved and reopened. A regression where setFieldValue updates the widget cache but fails to write /V (value lost on save) passes.

The saved file is validated only by reopen + pageCount()==3. A save that rebinds correctly but silently DROPS the created annotation from the written PDF passes (reopened doc still has 3 pages, in-memory undo still decrements). User loses their annotation on disk with a green test.

save() could silently drop/corrupt page content (wrong text/images, lost annotations) and stay green — it only checks file exists, >0 bytes, reopens non-null (L139-142). Nothing compares any page content or object before/after.
Metadata set in the in-memory model but readMetadata runs on the same live doc (never reopened from disk); a save that drops the metadata edit passes.
Asserts only that toggled radio B != "Off" (L176); never re-reads radio A to confirm it was DESELECTED. A radio group that fails to clear the sibling (the exact bug the test is named for) passes.

Sole real assertion is EXPECT_GE((int)FormFieldType::Signature,0) (L489) — a compile-time tautology — then SUCCEED(); sigCount/totalCount discarded via (void). If getFormFields mis-tags signature widgets the UI dispatches the wrong dialog and this never notices.

The test emits pageMoved(0,2) itself then checks the spy caught (0,2); no drag-drop code path is exercised, so a broken/never-fired reorder handler in PagePanel is undetected — it only proves Qt signal plumbing works. Same for MultiSelectDelete (L316).

Bare try/catch with ZERO assertions. DeletePageCommand at INT_MAX/-1 could delete the wrong page or silently no-op WITHOUT throwing and the test passes; it neither asserts a throw nor that page count is unchanged.

Pages requested reverse {2,1,0} but emitted forward; only pageCount==3 checked, so page-order not being honored ships green. Same class as ExtractPages_Multiple (L61) which can extract the wrong pages.

A willSave/AA script that silently fails to execute passes: the test only asserts fireDocumentEvent doesn't throw (L180-182) and documents it cannot observe the script ran (L139-150). A regression disabling doc-level JS stays green.
Verifies only reopen + pageCount()==3 (L104). A save that drops/mangles page content but preserves the page count passes — no content or object comparison.
Compares test_3page.pdf against itself, expecting similarity~1.0 and changedPages==0. A comparator hardwired to return 1.0/0 changes (i.e. one that never detects any difference) passes this test.

After injected rename failure, the recovery saveAs(otherPath) is checked only by NO_THROW + reopened pageCount>0. The inserted blank page (the edit that would be lost) is never confirmed in otherPath, so a recovery save writing a PRE-EDIT file passes.
Export emits empty-valued fields (what the name forbids). The body admits it can't check content, checks only '<fields>' exists, then SUCCEED() — an export including empty values passes.

The batch action (FlattenAnnotations) silently does nothing or fails; comment 'May succeed or fail depending on file content' (L133) means it asserts only fileResults.size()==1 — an action that never mutates the PDF passes.

Post-move identity asserted only via widthPt/heightPt equality; test_3page.pdf pages share dimensions, so a MovePage landing at the wrong index (or not moving) yields identical dims and passes. No content/label/object identity checked.

Only page 0 and last index are content-checked after a 500-page reversal. A full-rewrite bug that scrambles/duplicates/drops INTERIOR pages survives (pageCount==500 also survives a swap-without-loss).

Both tests are bare try/catch with ZERO assertions (L71-96). saveAs to a 300-char or UNC path could crash-recover into a silently corrupt/partial file and the test passes as long as it neither throws nor crashes; no file-state or exception oracle.
Name promises a throw on a path-less Document; body opens a normal doc and EXPECT_NO_THROW's saveIncremental() (L177). The defensive throw branch is never reached, so a removed guard is undetected.

EXPECT_GE(bookmarks.size(),0u) is always true on unsigned (L74); on the no-outline fixture the validation loop never runs (L35). A broken extractor returning garbage/empty passes as 'ran without crashing'.
Applies a reversed range (7,3) with a 'should not crash' comment but contains ZERO EXPECT_/ASSERT_. A silently corrupted run list from a reversed range is never checked — only a crash fails it.

Widgets can exist by objectName yet be disabled/unwired; a metadata dialog that displays fields but never pushes an EditMetadataCommand on OK (user's edit silently discarded) passes every test in this file — the dialog is never connected to a Document/save path anywhere in the suite.

The OCR oracle asserts invalidated.size()==3/ocred.size()==3 where those sets are filled by the command's OWN callback lambdas — it verifies the command re-invokes callbacks it was constructed with, not real document OCR state. A command firing callbacks but leaving OCR state stale passes.
